# jaff.config.loader

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Loading of the `jaff.toml` / `jaffgen.toml` config.

Every config source (a file, the command line, a Python `dict`) is a *layer*:
a nested `dict` in the shape of the config file.  The layers are merged with
`deep_merge`, the later one winning, and the result is validated against
the module-owned config models.

## Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`atomic_tables`](atomic_tables.md) | Return the `deep_merge` `atomic` check derived from *model*. |
| [`deep_merge`](deep_merge.md) | Merge config *layers*, a later layer winning over an earlier one. |
| [`dump_config`](dump_config.md) | Write *config* as TOML text: every key, defaults included. |
| [`load_config`](load_config.md) | Merge config *layers* and validate the result against *model*. |
| [`load_layer`](load_layer.md) | Read the TOML file *path* as a layer, its paths resolved against its directory. |
| [`resolve_paths`](resolve_paths.md) | Return a copy of *layer* with its relative paths resolved against *base_dir*. |
